Voice of Korea FAQ

What frequency is Voice of Korea on?
In the A-26 season Voice of Korea is scheduled on 26 shortwave frequencies, including 6070, 6170, 6185, 7210, 7220, 7235 kHz. Best evening option for eastern North America: 11735 kHz (12 am – 1 am Eastern). For Europe: 9425 kHz (7 pm – 8 pm UTC+1).

Can I hear Voice of Korea in the USA?
Yes. Voice of Korea is beamed at North America this season on 9435, 11710 kHz; the best evening option for eastern North America is 11735 kHz (12 am – 1 am Eastern).

Does Voice of Korea broadcast in English on shortwave?
Yes. English broadcasts this season: 6170 kHz at 10:00–11:00 UTC to LAm; 6185 kHz at 10:00–11:00 UTC to SE Asia; 7210 kHz at 19:00–20:00 UTC to S. Africa; 7220 kHz at 04:00–05:00 UTC to Far East; 7220 kHz at 06:00–07:00 UTC to Far East; plus 36 more.

Is Voice of Korea on the air right now?
As of Thursday, September 24, 2026, 10:00 UTC, Voice of Korea is scheduled to be broadcasting on 6070 kHz to Japan. This is based on the published schedule at the time this page was built; check the live search for up-to-the-minute status.
